name: @tangle-network/agent-embed
description: Drop-in <tangle-agent> web component for embedding any Tangle-marketplace agent into any website.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --dts --format esm --out-dir dist && tsup src/standalone.ts --format iife --global-name TangleAgent --minify --out-dir dist && mv dist/standalone.js dist/embed.js 2>/dev/null || mv dist/standalone.global.js dist/embed.js 2>/dev/null || true
